explication: UndertaleModTool is a GameMaker data-file modding suite. A user opens a data.win-like file through the GUI or CLI; binary IO materializes an UndertaleData model, which editors, project assets, scripts, search, and decompiler/compiler workflows transform. Serialization then writes a repaired data file or exported project/debug artifacts. The README documents broader asset editing, room editing, scripting, project systems, and yydebug generation; several UI and export connections are inferred only at subsystem level because their implementations were not sampled.
